summary: Riley Exploration Permian filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026, disclosing that subsidiary Riley Exploration-Permian, LLC voluntarily prepaid in full $130.0 million principal of its 10.50% Senior Unsecured Notes due 2028 on October 5, 2026, at 100% of principal plus accrued interest, with no prepayment premium. The repayment was funded with $130 million drawn under the Truist-administered Credit Agreement, leaving total borrowings of $245 million against a $425 million borrowing base and $400 million elected commitments. No special-situation event; a routine debt refinancing with a non-cash extinguishment loss expected.
